links.outcome: Readability (SMOG) of chatbot patient information on orthodontic tooth extractions
links.effect: All three chatbots produced text requiring college-level education to comprehend by SMOG index; Claude 3.5 Sonnet had the highest readability values, with quality and accuracy generally high.
links.quote: In terms of readability, as measured by the SMOG index, all three AI-based chatbots required a college-level education for comprehension.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM chatbots (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini, etc.) answering patient questions regarding orthodontic tooth extractions, evaluating quality, accuracy, and readability without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
